Hi there, and thanks for contacting Leafy! 🌿

Unfortunately, no. Changes made on or after the 25th apply to the **following** month's box, so next month's box will still be your current plan. Your Collector plan would start with the box after that.

- Your next month's box was already billed on the 25th, and it will ship in the first full week of next month as your current plan.
- If you switch today, your first Collector box (a medium or rare plant in a 6-inch pot, $49/month) would be the one billed on the 25th of next month.
- To make the change, go to "Account" > "Subscriptions". There's no fee for changing plans.

If you'd like your first Collector box to be as soon as possible, switching now is the way to get it lined up. I can't change what's already been billed for next month's box.

Happy growing, and please reach out any time if you have more questions! 🪴
